lines.lyric_translation: The beginning was quite fun
Just with all the ups and downs
But suddenly, we’re tired
From a waste of meaningless emotions
A repeating seesaw seesaw game
Now I’m sick of it, sick of it
A repeating seesaw seesaw game
We’re getting tired, tired of each other
Were the little arguments the start?
The moment I became heavier than you
Because there was never a parallel from the start
Maybe I became more greedy and tried to fit in with you
Is there really a need to keep repeating ourselves
Saying this was love and this is love?

lines.lyric: Seoro jichyeotgo gateun kadeureul jwigo itneun deuthae
lines.lyric_hangul: 서로 지쳤고 같은 카드를 쥐고 있는 듯해
lines.lyric_translation: We’re both tired and holding onto the same card
If so, then…
Alright, a repeating seesaw seesaw game
Trying to end it now
Alright, sick of this seesaw game
Someone needs to get off right here
Though neither of us can

lines.lyric: Nuga naerilji maljin seoro nunchi malgo
lines.lyric_hangul: 누가 내릴지 말진 서로 눈치 말고
lines.lyric_translation: Let’s not scope out who’s gonna get off first

lines.lyric: Geujeo mam ganeun daero jiljil kkeulji malgo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그저 맘 가는 대로 질질 끌지 말고
lines.lyric_translation: Let’s not drag things out, however our hearts lead us
Let’s make the ending, whoever will get off
This repeating seesaw game
Let’s stop it now
People can be so sly

lines.lyric: Han myeongi eopseum dachil geol almyeonseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 한 명이 없음 다칠 걸 알면서
lines.lyric_translation: They know they’ll get hurt if one person is missing
But no one wants to be the bad guy
So there’s an ambiguous continuation of passing on responsibilities

lines.lyric: Jichil mankeum jichyeoseo dweryeo pyeonghaengi dwaetne
lines.lyric_hangul: 지칠 만큼 지쳐서 되려 평행이 됐네
lines.lyric_translation: And we get so tired or if that we finally became parallel

lines.lyric: Ay ireon pyeonghaengeul baran geon aninde
lines.lyric_hangul: Ay 이런 평행을 바란 건 아닌데
lines.lyric_translation: But we didn’t want this kind of parallel
At first, we showed off who was heavier
As we looked at each other and smiled
Now we’re competing against each other
Trying to win over who’s heavier
It becomes the fire to our fights
It’ll only end if someone gets off right here
We’re acting like we’re comforting each other
But it’s mixed with thorns
Can’t keep doing this, we need to make a decision
If we didn’t have feelings for each other
If we didn’t think of each other
Would we have dragged it out like this?
Now if you don’t have any more feelings
This seesaw is dangerous
Stop thinking about me
Alright, a repeating seesaw seesaw game
Trying to end it now
Alright, sick of this seesaw game
Someone needs to get off right here
Though neither of us can

lines.lyric: Hol’ up hol’ up niga eopneun i shiso wireul georeo
lines.lyric_hangul: (Hol' up Hol' up) 니가 없는 이 시소 위를 걸어
lines.lyric_translation: Hol’ up hol’ up I’m walking on this seesaw without you

lines.lyric: Hol’ up hol’ up niga eobtteon cheoeume geuttaecheoreom
lines.lyric_hangul: (Hol' up Hol' up) 니가 없던 처음의 그때처럼
lines.lyric_translation: Hol’ up hol’ up just like the beginning when you weren’t here
